hearth.lives.option.ambitious_apprentice: Bring the stuff for the masterpiece
hearth.lives.option.drunk_smith.priest: Take him to the priest to swear a vow
hearth.lives.option.drunk_smith.talk: Talk him out of the bottle
hearth.lives.option.exile_come_home.vouc: Vouch for them to the elders
hearth.lives.option.gossip.feed: Feed her a tale of your own
hearth.lives.option.miser_merchant.persu: Persuade him that giving is good business
hearth.lives.option.old_soldier.find: Find him a sword like the one he lost
hearth.lives.option.old_soldier.listen: Listen to the whole of his story
hearth.lives.option.poacher.share: Take a share of the meat
hearth.lives.option.runaway.coin: Give them coin for the road
hearth.lives.option.widow_at_well.roof: Pay a roofer to mend her house
hearth.lives.option.young_lovers.elope: Give them coin for the road
hearth.lives.option.young_lovers.speak: Speak for them to their families
hearth.lives.people.intro: Folk you would want to know:
hearth.lives.people.none: Nobody worth the telling. We are plain folk here.
Wants the stuff for a masterpiece, before the time is served.
First at the bench and last to leave.
Made the masterpiece early; a master before the time.
Had words with the master; bides the time now.
Has gone to seek a fairer master in another town.
Will be a master in good time, and a good one.
Says the master holds them back.
Waiting on the stuff for the masterpiece.
hearth.lives.story.drunk_smith.complaint: Folk grumble about crooked nails and hinges that snap.
hearth.lives.story.drunk_smith.debt: The steward presses for a debt the forge cannot pay.
hearth.lives.story.drunk_smith.drinking: Drinks every night, and the work at the forge suffers.
hearth.lives.story.drunk_smith.forge_los: The forge went to the apprentice. Sits by the gate with the old soldier.
hearth.lives.story.drunk_smith.sober: Sober, and the apprentice back at the bellows. Owes a kindness to whoever helped.
hearth.lives.story.drunk_smith.sworn_off: Has sworn off the drink, for now.
hearth.lives.story.drunk_smith.vowed: Has sworn a vow at the altar, candles burning.
hearth.lives.story.drunk_smith.vowing: Waiting on candles for a vow at the altar.
hearth.lives.story.exile_come_home.old_w: An old wrong with the a neighbouring household comes up again.
hearth.lives.story.exile_come_home.retur: Came home after years away; the welcome is cold.
hearth.lives.story.exile_come_home.settl: Has taken work and keeps head down.
hearth.lives.story.exile_come_home.welco: Welcomed back at the family table.
hearth.lives.story.gossip.feud_brews: The tale has set two houses at each other's throats.
hearth.lives.story.gossip.forgotten: A new tale has taken the old one's place.
hearth.lives.story.gossip.quashed: Corrected in front of the market; the tale is dead.
hearth.lives.story.gossip.shunned: Folk keep their secrets from her now.
hearth.lives.story.gossip.spreading: The tale is all over the market.
hearth.lives.story.gossip.whispers: Has a tale going about the a neighbouring household.
hearth.lives.story.healer.fever: A fever in the lanes, and too few herbs.
hearth.lives.story.healer.gathering: Waiting on herbs from the woods.
hearth.lives.story.healer.lost_one: Lost a child to the fever, and blames herself.
hearth.lives.story.healer.saved: The fever is beaten; folk bless whoever helped.
hearth.lives.story.healer.short: Short of herbs; the shelves are bare.
hearth.lives.story.miller_in_debt.debt: Owes more than the mill earns.
hearth.lives.story.miller_in_debt.eased: The lender agreed to wait a season.
hearth.lives.story.miller_in_debt.free: Clear of debt; the mill turns for its own again.
hearth.lives.story.miller_in_debt.mill_l: Lost the mill for the debt; the houses no longer speak.
hearth.lives.story.miller_in_debt.presse: The lender wants the money by harvest.
hearth.lives.story.miser_merchant.alone: Sits alone among the coin; nobody calls.
hearth.lives.story.miser_merchant.gives: Gave to the town; folk tip their hats now.
hearth.lives.story.miser_merchant.hoardi: Counts the coin twice and gives nothing.
hearth.lives.story.miser_merchant.humble: Robbed and humbled; kinder to the poor since.
hearth.lives.story.miser_merchant.refuse: Refused a share for the town's well and works.
hearth.lives.story.old_soldier.banner: Speaks of the sword lost at the ford, forty years gone.
hearth.lives.story.old_soldier.blade_hom: The old sword hangs over the door; drills the boys of a morning.
hearth.lives.story.old_soldier.drills: Drills the town's boys in the square of a morning.
hearth.lives.story.old_soldier.heard: Someone heard the whole of the story at last.
hearth.lives.story.old_soldier.passed: Died in sleep, by the fire.
hearth.lives.story.old_soldier.war_story: Tells the same war story on the bench at noon.
hearth.lives.story.pious_pilgrim.blessed: Blessed for the road with a stranger's alms.
hearth.lives.story.pious_pilgrim.departs: On the road to the shrine.
hearth.lives.story.pious_pilgrim.lost: Never came back from the road.
hearth.lives.story.pious_pilgrim.returns: Back from the shrine, with a blessing for those who gave.
hearth.lives.story.pious_pilgrim.vow: Has vowed a pilgrimage to the far shrine.
hearth.lives.story.poacher.caught: Caught with a deer on the back; set in the pillory.
hearth.lives.story.poacher.covered: Covered for; still out of a night.
hearth.lives.story.poacher.reformed: Made the lord's huntsman: a thief set to catch thieves.
hearth.lives.story.poacher.snares: Sets snares in the lord's wood by night.
hearth.lives.story.poacher.suspected: The steward's men have found the snares.
hearth.lives.story.runaway.gone: Gone one night, down the road.
hearth.lives.story.runaway.plans: Has a bundle packed under the bed.
hearth.lives.story.runaway.restless: Talks of nothing but the road.
hearth.lives.story.runaway.stays: Has taken to the trade after all.
hearth.lives.story.runaway.watched: Kept close by the family, and sulking.
hearth.lives.story.widow_at_well.alone: The house is too quiet; talks to anyone at the well.
hearth.lives.story.widow_at_well.mournin: Keeps to the well of a morning and the grave on the rest day.
hearth.lives.story.widow_at_well.new_pur: Minds the town's little ones by the well while their mothers work.
hearth.lives.story.widow_at_well.withdra: Has gone to live with her sister in another town.
hearth.lives.story.young_lovers.blessed: The houses have given their blessing; the banns will follow.
hearth.lives.story.young_lovers.eloped: Ran off together in the night.
hearth.lives.story.young_lovers.forbidde: Kept apart by the families, and pining.
hearth.lives.story.young_lovers.found_ou: The families found them out; there was shouting in the street.
hearth.lives.story.young_lovers.parted: Parted for good; the feud goes on.
hearth.lives.story.young_lovers.secret: Meets a sweetheart in secret; their houses would never have it.
hearth.lives.talk.condole: I am sorry for your loss.
hearth.lives.talk.condole.reply: Thank you. It helps, a little.
hearth.lives.talk.peace.no: You do not know what they did.
hearth.lives.talk.peace.yes: Maybe you are right. It has gone on long enough.
hearth.lives.talk.people: Who are the folk of note here?
hearth.lives.talk.reward: I have not forgotten what you did. Here, this is for you.
